image_description: A close-up, black-and-white photograph of a motorcycle braking system. The image features a perforated metal brake disc (rotor) with visible cross-drilled holes and machined slots. A caliper assembly is mounted over the edge of the rotor, containing brake pads. Various mechanical linkages, hydraulic lines, and mounting brackets are visible in the background, creating a complex industrial composition.
